decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

<p style="margin-left: 1px; padding: 0cm 5.4pt;"><span style="line-height: 107%;">The outbuilding hereby permitted shall only be used for purposes incidental (such as for storage purposes or a gym) to the enjoyment of the first floor flat located at 127 Bellamy Drive, Stanmore, Harrow, HA7 2DG and shall not be used as a separate unit of residential accommodation, without the prior permission in writing of the Local Planning Authority.</span></p><p style="margin: 0cm 0cm 0cm 26px; padding: 0cm 5.4pt; text-align: justify;"><br></p>

<p><span style="line-height:normal">Notwithstanding the approved details, the development hereby approved shall not be first occupied until details of secured and sheltered cycle storage for 2 bicycles per flat, located within the rear gardens have been submitted to, and agreed in writing by, the Local Planning Authority. Thereafter, the approved cycle storage shall be made available prior to the occupation of the development in accordance with the approved details and shall thereafter be retained.</span></p>

<p><span style="line-height:normal">The refuse and waste bins shall be made available prior to the first occupation of the development and the bins shall be stored at all times in the flat’s respective rear amenity spaces, other than on collection days.</span></p>

<p><span style="line-height:normal">All planting, seeding or turfing comprised in the approved details of landscaping shall be carried out in the first planting and seeding seasons following the occupation of the building(s), or the completion of the development, whichever is the sooner. Any existing or new trees or shrubs which, within a period of 5 years from the completion of the development, die, are removed, or become seriously damaged or diseased, shall be replaced in the next planting season, with others of a similar size and species, unless the local authority agrees any variation in writing. The boundary treatment including the side gate shall be completed before the development is occupied. The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details and shall thereafter be retained.</span></p>

<p style="margin-bottom: 0cm; margin-right: 0cm; margin-top: 0cm; padding: 0cm 5.4pt;"><span style="line-height:normal">Prior to occupation of the development, a Fire Safety Statement shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority, this statement shall include details of how the development will function in terms of the following:</span></p><p style="margin: 0cm 0cm 0cm 1px; padding: 0cm 5.4pt;"><span style="line-height:normal">1) identify suitably positioned unobstructed outside space: a) for fire appliances to be positioned on b) appropriate for use as an evacuation assembly point</span></p><p style="margin: 0cm 0cm 0cm 1px; padding: 0cm 5.4pt;"><span style="line-height:normal">2) is designed to incorporate appropriate features which reduce the risk to life and the risk of serious injury in the event of a fire; including appropriate fire alarm systems and passive and active fire safety measures</span></p><p style="margin: 0cm 0cm 0cm 1px; padding: 0cm 5.4pt;"><span style="line-height:normal">3) is constructed in an appropriate way to minimise the risk of fire spread</span></p><p style="margin: 0cm 0cm 0cm 1px; padding: 0cm 5.4pt;"><span style="line-height:normal">4) provide suitable and convenient means of escape, and associated evacuation strategy for all building users</span></p><p style="margin: 0cm 0cm 0cm 1px; padding: 0cm 5.4pt;"><span style="line-height:normal">5) develop a robust management strategy for evacuation which is to be periodically updated and published (details of how often this management strategy is to be reviewed and published to be included), and which all building users can have confidence in</span></p><p style="margin: 0cm 0cm 0cm 1px; padding: 0cm 5.4pt;"><span style="line-height:normal">6) provide suitable access and equipment for firefighting which is appropriate for the size and use of the development.</span></p><p style="margin: 0cm 0cm 0cm 1px; padding: 0cm 5.4pt;"><span style="line-height:normal">The development shall be operated in accordance with the approved details in perpetuity.</span></p><p style="margin: 0cm 0cm 0cm 1px; padding: 0cm 5.4pt;"><br></p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="">Notwithstanding the approved plans and
elevations, amended plans and elevations showing a correct illustration of the
siting of windows/doors on all external elevations, including annotations
regarding obscure glazing, shall be submitted to be approved in writing by the
Local Planning Authority. The development shall not be occupied until such
approval is issued and the fenestration shall remain as approved in perpetuity.
<o:p></o:p></p><p>

</p><p class="MsoListParagraph" style=""><br></p>

<p>The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents: PA/127/E.01 Rev A; PA/127/P.01 Rev A; PA/127/P.03 Rev A; PA/127/P.04; PA/127/P.05; PA/127/P.06; PA/127/P.07; PA/127/P.08 Rev B; PA/127/P.09; PA/127/P.10; Reasonable Exception Statement; Flood Risk Assessment; Design &amp; Access Statement; Site Location Plan.</p>

<p><span style="line-height:normal">Notwithstanding the approved details, the development hereby permitted shall not be occupied until there has been a scheme of hard and soft landscape works for the site submitted to, and approved by, the local planning authority. Soft landscape works shall include planting plans, including details for soft landscaping of the property frontage with provision for a maximum of one on-site car parking space, and schedules of plants, noting species, plant sizes and proposed numbers / densities. Hard landscape works shall include; details of boundary treatments (materials, scale of boundary, location) to demarcate access to, and the boundaries between, the subdivided rear garden, details (siting, materials, size, type of storage unit) of bin storage facilities to be provided within the rear gardens of the individual flats, allocation of one car parking space (2.4m x 4.8m) on the front forecourt, details of hard surfacing materials to be used in the landscaping of the site.</span></p>
description:
Conversion of dwelling into two flats (2 x 1 beds); external
alterations; parking; separate amenity space; boundary treatment; hard and soft
landscaping; bin / cycle storage; front porch; outbuilding.
